question: Who among the following had laid the foundation of Lodi dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahlul Lodi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bahlol Lodi is the founder of the Lodi dynasty.
 
• In 1479, the Sharqi Empire lost Jaunpur and Hussain Shah fled to Bengal. 
 
• The graves of most of the Sharqi sultans and their nobles are close to the Jama Masjid.
 
• He won Jaunpur in 1484 and merged it in the Delhi sultanate. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
